E0220

A place is read through its owner while an exclusive write window into it is still live.

What

A place is read through its owner while an exclusive write window into it is still live.

Why

An exclusive window (a pin or a mutable view) already gives write access to that storage; reading the owner beside it would be rejected after lowering.

Fix

Read or edit through the live window name instead of the owner.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0220: tests/ui/ownership/map_value_window_blocks_map_growth.stderr.

Error [jet.ReadDuringWriteWindow]: `counts` cannot be read while `c` has a live exclusive write window into it
  --> tests/ui/ownership/map_value_window_blocks_map_growth.jet:9:5
    |
  9 |     counts["z"] = 1
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: `c` is an exclusive window into `counts`; reading the owner beside that window would be rejected after lowering
 Fix: Read or edit through `c` instead of `counts`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0220

Error [jet.OwnerMovedWhileViewed]: `counts[…]` cannot be assigned while `c` is still looking into it
  --> tests/ui/ownership/map_value_window_blocks_map_growth.jet:9:11
    |
  9 |     counts["z"] = 1
    |           ^^^^^
 Why: `c` is a live exclusive mutable view into `counts`; changing or moving the owner could invalidate that view
 Fix: Finish using `c` before changing `counts[…]`, narrow the view's scope, or make an owned copy
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0212
